notes: A rate paid is read on chain over a past window. Past rates do not promise future rates.
A fact shows its answer and its sources once a person has checked it against them. Until then it reads being checked, with no answer and no link.

measure.label: Rate paid over 30 days
measure.definition: The rate a product paid over the last 30 days, read on chain, as a yearly rate in percent. Dollar savings and ETH staking are ranked apart. A product whose rate is not known sits under the ones with a rate.

data.order_rule: Ordered by the rate paid over the last 30 days, from highest to lowest. A product whose rate is not known yet sits under the ones with a rate. A tie is broken A to Z. Paying changes nothing.

facts.what: who can put money in: anyone with a wallet, or a KYC, allowlist or country limit
facts.text_as_published: On Ethereum you stake through Frax's Hop contract; the token's own deposit and redeem are switched off. No KYC is described.

facts.what: whether anyone can freeze or block a holder, and who
facts.text_as_published: Yes. Frax can freeze an address, burn tokens and pause on frxUSD. A minter role can burn sfrxUSD from any holder.

facts.what: how a holder gets out, and any wait, cooldown or queue
facts.text_as_published: No lockup. Stake and unstake at any time through the Hop contract.

facts.what: the cut taken from the yield
facts.text_as_published: Frax states zero staking or unstaking fees, but the Hop contract asks a small fee in ETH. On Ethereum the rate is set through a timelock.

facts.what: who can put money in: anyone with a wallet, or a KYC, allowlist or country limit
facts.text_as_published: No KYC to stake and hold, but sUSDe is not offered in the EU or EEA, and Ethena's terms bar the US and other listed places. Minting and redeeming USDe is for whitelisted users who pass KYC.

facts.what: whether anyone can freeze or block a holder, and who
facts.text_as_published: Yes. Ethena can fully restrict an address so it cannot send or receive sUSDe, and its admin can move that wallet's balance to another address.

facts.what: how a holder gets out, and any wait, cooldown or queue
facts.text_as_published: A cooldown after you ask to unstake: 1, 3, 5 or 7 days since March 2026, starting at 1 day. Ethena's admin can set up to 90 days.

facts.what: the cut taken from the yield
facts.text_as_published: No fee on the sUSDe yield is stated. Ethena puts 0% of revenue into its reserve fund today.

facts.text_as_published: Anyone with a wallet. The vault has no access gate set (read on chain on November 26, 2026).

facts.what: whether anyone can freeze or block a holder, and who
facts.text_as_published: No gate is set today. The curator can add gates that block exits; changes wait out the vault's timelock, which can be 0 to 3 weeks. Circle can block an address from moving USDC.

facts.what: how a holder gets out, and any wait, cooldown or queue
facts.text_as_published: Withdrawals draw on cash in the vault and on what it can pull from its markets at once.

facts.what: the cut taken from the yield
facts.text_as_published: 0% today (read on chain on November 26, 2026). The curator can set up to 50% of the interest and 5% a year of the money inside, after a timelock.
